\"ACT ≥20 + redução ≥50% nas exacerbaçõe: "ACT ≥20 + reduction ≥50% in exacerbations" is composed — each isolated component may not be significant.
\"Anafilaxia perioperatória é o iceberg: "Perioperative anaphylaxis is the iceberg of hospital allergy — what the anesthesiologist sees is the crisis, but what the allergist needs to investigate is the complete repertoire. Tryptase collected 4h after the reaction and compared to basal can reveal underlying mastocytosis in 5-8% of cases — a patient who will reanesthetize without prophylaxis and will have an even more severe reaction. The new algorithm gives us the correct sequence; The error is not to follow.
\"Esse trial é um marco — mas precisamos: "This trial is a milestone — but we need to read the numbers carefully. The absolute difference of 7,5% in EASI-75 has NNT of 13. That is, for every 13 patients who change from dupilumab to Jaki, only 1 will have additional response. But this 1 patient will have a higher risk of herpes zoster, and all 13 will have greater cost and less access. The clinical decision is not about which one works better on the role — it is about which patient phenotype, at what time of disease, with which risk profile."
\"FeNO é a janela para o epitélio inflam: "FeNO is the window to the inflamed epithelium — but it is a window, not a door. It tells us that IL-13 is active; does not tell us that dupilumabe will work better than tezepelumab in that specific patient. What this study offers us is a physiologically coherent hypothesis to refine the selection. My priority criterion is: phenotyping with eosinophils, IgE, FeNO and a history of atopy together — never an isolated marker.
\"O barzolvolimabe não é mais um anti-Ig: "Barzolvolimabe is no longer an anti-IgE — it is a turn of mechanistic paradigm. While the omalizumab dried the trigger (IgE), the anti-KIT eliminates the executor (mastocyte). In a patient with USC refractory to omalizumab, with IgE low and normal tryptase, this would be the next logical step. But it is still phase II — off-label and experimental use. My service follows the EAACI guideline: optimized omalizumab before any other option."
\"O diagnóstico tardio de 7 anos na IDCV: "The late diagnosis of 7 years in IDCV is not a failure of the patient — it is a systemic screening failure. An adult with 3 pneumonias before 40 years, without identified cause, has IDCV until proven otherwise. The immunoglobulin dosage costs less than R$150 and is available in SUS. The ML model is elegant, but the most powerful tool remains the allergist-immunologist trained to recognize the clinical pattern."
\"Quando vemos uma redução de 72% em exa: "When we see a reduction of 72% in exacerbations, we need to ask: regarding what? This study has no active comparator. What really tells us is that tezepelumab maintains efficacy beyond 2 years in the real world — but not that it is superior to other biological ones. The decision still needs to be phenotypic: TSLP for the patient without marker T2, IL-5 for pure eosinophilic, dupilumabe for the atopic with comorbidities. The specialist who prescribes biological without phenotyping is making empirical expensive."

Food allergy is a reproducible immune reaction to food — different from intolerance, which does not involve the immune system. The most associated foods are milk, egg, wheat, soybean, peanuts, nuts, fish and seafood. The diagnosis combines detailed clinical history, skin tests or specific IgE and, when indicated, supervised oral provocation test. Tests performed without criteria generate false-positive results and unnecessary diets. Reaction with shortness of breath, repeated vomiting or after eating is anaphylaxis: seek emergency.

O que os estudos demonstraram: MENSA dem: What the studies showed: MENSA demonstrated reduction of exacerbations; SIRIUS, reduction of the need for oral corticosteroids with improvement in control; SYNAPSE, improvement of the polyps and nasal obstruction in severe CRScPN.
O que os estudos demonstraram: Measure U: What the studies showed: Measure Up 1/2 demonstrated significant improvement of lesions versus placebo. In the Heads Up, 30 mg/day provided faster response and greater cutaneous efficacy than dupilumabe in the studied period, with a higher frequency of some infections and laboratory abnormalities.
O que os estudos demonstraram: NAVIGATOR: What the studies showed: NAVIGATOR demonstrated less exacerbations and improvement of pulmonary function, control and quality of life, with benefit also in the group with eosinophils below 300/μL. In severe CSRcPN, WAYPOINT showed improvement in polyps and symptoms and less use of systemic surgery/corticoside.
O que os estudos demonstraram: No HELP,: What the studies have shown: In HELP, significantly reduced attack versus placebo frequency in patients with type I/II AEH, supporting its preventive use.
O que os estudos demonstraram: No JADE C: What the studies showed: In JADE COMPARE, 100 and 200 mg/day improved signs and symptoms versus placebo. The dose of 200 mg was higher than dupilumab for pruritus response at week 2; Most of the other main comparisons at week 16 showed no significant difference.
O que os estudos demonstraram: No VANGUA: What the studies showed: In VANGUARD, it significantly reduced attacks versus placebo over six months in participants with 12 years or more, with a favorable safety profile during the study period.
O que os estudos demonstraram: No ZONDA,: What the studies showed: In ZONDA, reduced the need for oral corticosteroids and exacerbations versus placebo. In recurrent/refractory GEPA, MANDARA showed no inferiority to mepolizumab for remission in the studied context.
